periods.label: Aingram Group head and Philphy's sister

status.role: organizes engagement party and supports Lux politically through commerce

periods.summary: Philphy's older sister and leader of the Aingram Group. She gathers wealthy merchants for Lux and Philphy's engagement announcement, mediates business interests around the new king, and cheerfully supports the couple.

philphy-aignram.summary: Dotes on her and celebrates her marriage to Lux.

lux-arcadia.summary: Uses Aingram influence to support his new kingship.

key_events.summary: Hosts the engagement party and buffers Lux from merchant negotiations.
